name: Cultist: Improved Sermon of Dread boosts Sermon of Dread by 40% through a native spell mod (#3018)
contract: 706177 is SpellFamilyName 31, effect0 ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108), MiscValue=3 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT1), BasePoints=39 -> CalcValue 40, SpellClassMask [0,0,268435456] (dword2 bit28). Every Sermon of Dread rank (620610-620614) is SpellFamilyName 31 with SpellFamilyFlags[2]=268435456, an exact classmask match, and no other family-31 spell carries that bit. Player::ApplySpellMod applies a percent SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 mod as basevalue*(1+0.40) with zero custom C++ (Player.cpp ~10275). Regression guard for behaviour that already works natively.
